title: Kerr Protocol
description: A spinning black hole rendered in real time from hand-written GLSL — no engine, no library, no npm package in the shipped page. GLM-5.3 built it agentically in Claude Code over 15 hours and 749 tool calls: null geodesics integrated per pixel in Kerr spacetime, an accretion disk coloured from the Planck curve with Doppler beaming, a volumetric jet, and a lensed sky. Being a non-vision model, it judged every frame through an outside vision model, and wrote a ten-check self-test that measures the physics from the pixels — shadow radius against 3√3 M, frame dragging, ISCO tracking, lensing against a numpy ground truth. Press T to run it.
